name: Guardrails
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Guardrails node to enforce safety, security, and content policies on text. You can use it to validate user input _before_ sending it to an AI model, or to check the _output_ from an AI model before using it in your workflow

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description: The operation mode for this node to define its behavior

parameters.name: Text To Check
parameters.description: The text the guardrails evaluate. Typically, you map this text using an expression from a previous node, such as text from a user query or a response from an AI model

parameters.name: Guardrails
parameters.description: Select one or more guardrails to apply to the Text To Check. When you add a guardrail from the list, its specific configuration options appear below
options: Keywords: Checks if specified keywords appear in the input text
Keywords: A comma-separated list of words to block
Jailbreak: Detects attempts to bypass AI safety measures or exploit the model
NSFW: Detects attempts to generate Not Safe For Work (NSFW) content
PII: Detects personally identifiable information (PII) in the text
Type: Choose which PII entities to scan for:
All: Scans for all available entity types
Selected: Allows you to choose specific entities from a list
Secret Keys: Detects the presence of secret keys or API credentials in the text
Custom: Define your own custom, LLM-based guardrail
Prompt: A prompt that instructs the AI model what to check for
Custom Regex: Define your own custom regular expression patterns

parameters.name: Customize System Message
parameters.description: If you turn this on, a text input appears with a message that the guardrail uses to enforce thresholds and JSON output according to schema. Change it to modify the global guardrails behavior

parameters.name: guardrailsUsage
parameters.displayName: Use guardrails to validate text against a set of policies (e.g. NSFW, prompt injection) or to sanitize it (e.g. personal data, secret keys)

options.name: Check Text for Violations
options.description: Validate text against a set of policies (e.g. NSFW, prompt injection)

options.name: Sanitize Text
options.description: Redact text to mask personal data, secret keys, URLs, etc.

options.name: keywords
options.description: This guardrail checks if specified keywords appear in the input text and can be configured to trigger tripwires based on keyword matches. Multiple keywords can

options.name: jailbreak
options.description: Detects attempts to jailbreak or bypass AI safety measures

options.name: nsfw
options.description: Detects attempts to generate NSFW content

options.name: pii
options.description: Detects attempts to use personal data content

options.name: secretKeys
options.description: Detects attempts to use secret keys in the input text. Scans text for common patterns, applies entropy analysis to detect random-looking strings.

options.name: topicalAlignment
options.description: Detects attempts to stray from the business scope

options.name: urls
options.description: Blocks URLs that are not in the allowed list

parameters.name: customizeSystemMessage
parameters.description: Whether to customize the system message used by the guardrail to specify the output format
